Enum Class ShimFeature

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ShimFeature>
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.runtime.spi.ShimFeature
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ShimFeature>, Constable
public enum ShimFeature extends Enum<ShimFeature>
An optional part of the generated runtime shim, recorded while lowering the program's IR and consulted by
invalid reference 
RuntimeShim
so each include and helper block is emitted only when some generated code actually calls into it.
